title: The mechanism of Taohe Chengqi decoction in modulating inflammation and alleviating cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury in rats through regulation of the arachidonic acid metabolism pathway and PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Zijian; Wang, Hongyan; Wang, Yanchen; Yuan, Yifan; Wang, Yihan; Peng, Liang; Zhang, Gang; Gao, Jing; Yan, Yonggang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药桃核承气汤通过代谢组学与分子对接调控炎症信号通路治疗脑缺血再灌注损伤，分子对接仅作为辅助验证，核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Ischemic stroke (IS) remains a major global cause of mortality, and its incidence continues to increase despite advances in clinical treatment. Taohe Chengqi Decoction (THCQD), a traditional Chinese medicine formulation, has exhibited notable clinical efficacy in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI), although its active components and mechanisms remain elusive. In this study, an integrated strategy combining liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS), network pharmacology, untargeted metabolomics, and molecular docking was applied to elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic mechanisms of THCQD. A total of 84 compounds were identified, including 22 prototype blood-absorbed constituents, such as emodin, amygdalin, and resveratrol. Network pharmacology indicated that THCQD could primarily regulate the HIF-1 and PI3K/AKT signaling pathways. In a rat model of middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion (MCAO/R), THCQD significantly reduced inflammation and infarct volume, improved neurological function, and preserved brain tissue morphology. Metabolomics analysis further indicated that THCQD could modulate metabolic disturbances, particularly in arachidonic acid and glutathione metabolism. Western blotting and molecular docking confirmed that THCQD components could regulate the "PTGS2/ALOX15-NF-kappaB/PI3K/AKT-HIF-1alpha/VEGFA" signaling axis, thereby suppressing neuroinflammation and promoting cellular survival. Overall, these findings demonstrated that THCQD exerted therapeutic effects through multi-component, multi-target mechanisms, involving inflammatory regulation and metabolic restoration, providing new insights into its potential as a holistic treatment strategy for CIRI.
abstract_zh: 缺血性卒中（IS）仍是全球主要的死亡原因，尽管临床治疗取得进展，其发病率仍在持续上升。桃核承气汤（THCQD）作为一种中药复方，在脑缺血再灌注损伤（CIRI）中显示出显著的临床疗效，但其活性成分和作用机制尚不明确。本研究采用液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）、网络药理学、非靶向代谢组学和分子对接相结合的综合策略，以阐明THCQD的生物活性成分和治疗机制。共鉴定出84种化合物，包括22种原型血吸收成分，如大黄素、苦杏仁苷和白藜芦醇。网络药理学表明，THCQD主要调控HIF-1和PI3K/AKT信号通路。在大脑中动脉闭塞/再灌注（MCAO/R）大鼠模型中，THCQD显著减轻炎症和梗死体积，改善神经功能，并保护脑组织形态。代谢组学分析进一步表明，THCQD可调节代谢紊乱，尤其是花生四烯酸和谷胱甘肽代谢。Western blotting和分子对接证实，THCQD成分可调控“PTGS2/ALOX15-NF-kappaB/PI3K/AKT-HIF-1alpha/VEGFA”信号轴，从而抑制神经炎症并促进细胞存活。总体而言，这些发现表明THCQD通过多成分、多靶点机制发挥治疗作用，涉及炎症调节和代谢恢复，为其作为CIRI整体治疗策略的潜力提供了新见解。
